contracts.signal: Akamai 8-K: on September 24, 2026 Akamai and Jabil entered into a Build Request under their existing Master Services Agreement (May 23, 2019), under which Jabil provides Akamai contract manufacturing and related services including the manufacture of customized server hardware; Akamai authorized Jabil to purchase approximately $1.7 billion of memory components, paying Jabil the supplier invoice amounts on receipt, with Jabil holding the components on consignment as bailee and repurchasing them at cost as they are used. Akamai filed the Jabil Agreement as a material definitive agreement (Item 1.01).
